title: A Time-Varying Coefficient-Based Fixed-Time Neurodynamic Approach for Generalized Monotone Inclusion Problems and Its Applications
summary: This manuscript develops time-varying coefficients neurodynamic models (TVCNDMs) to solve the inclusion problem (IPs) $0 \in \mathcal{P}(w) + \mathcal{Q}(w)$, where $\mathcal{P}$ is a maximal set-valued and $\mathcal{Q}$ is a single-valued operator. The underlying operators are assumed to fulfill a generalized monotonicity condition that is less restrictive than the classical monotonicity assumption.
